model_limitations.baseline: Bootstrap resamples training rows and is non-generative.
model_limitations.flow: Phase 3A flow supports continuous-only tabular features with no missing values.
model_limitations.vae: Supports continuous and binary tabular features with Gaussian/Bernoulli observation assumptions.

reasons: Unconditional tabular data_generation is supported and budget permits VAE training.

planner: deterministic rules plus within-family searches and shared validation comparison; no LLM reasoning or autonomous optimization
selection: Selected baseline using shared validation selection_score; held-out test was not used.

validation_comparison.decision_rule: Select the method with the highest validation selection_score from synthetic-vs-validation evaluation. VAE ELBO and flow NLL are used only within their own family searches.
validation_comparison.metric_definition: selection_score = 0.45 train-scale-normalized marginal fidelity + 0.35 dependence preservation + 0.20 legacy marginal fidelity when correlations are valid; without correlations, 0.75 normalized marginal + 0.25 legacy marginal.
